meta.title: Session event popup
meta.description: When a turn ends, or the agent stops to ask a question or request approval, a notification names the session, its outcome, how long it ran and which folder it lives in — click it to jump back to that conversation. Which notices pop, whether you can answer right in the notice (question text and options, or allow once / allow for this session / deny), which sound each kind uses, how loud it is and when it stays quiet, all switchable on the plugin page (full write-up) or under Settings > Popups (switches only), effective immediately without a restart. The conversation on your screen stays quiet while every other session still pops; goal mode only announces the last round; adding a sound lives right under the sounds, and on Windows the taskbar icon can blink until the window comes forward (on by default). System sounds plus eight bundled ones ship in the box, and you can add your own .wav/.mp3 files. Subagent sessions are skipped by default. Notifications are attributed to DeepSeek Harness and follow the system do-not-disturb and per-app notification settings; disabling the plugin stops them. Windows and macOS, though macOS support is beta and may misbehave. On macOS it is a plain reminder: notices, sounds and click-to-jump work while the window runs, but the notices carry no buttons - answering an approval or a question from the notice is Windows only - and the taskbar blink is unavailable.
